say:2:1321760001:0.text: What activity is this? Why is there so much dough?
say:2:1321760001:0.source_cn: 这是什么项目？为什么也有这么多面团？

say:3:1321760002:1.text: This is called the <style="highlight">Doughball Fight</style>! Instead of a snowball fight, you use dough balls to try and hit the targets. Hit all of them, and you win.

say:4:1321760003:1.text: Is this another activity that Miss Lydia came up with...?

say:5:1321760004:1.text: Yes, after all, we all know that Her Highness can't handle anything strenuous or intense.
say:5:1321760004:1.source_cn: 是的……毕竟公主殿下的身体实在不适合剧烈运动。

say:6:1321760005:1.text: If we had a snowball fight, everyone would be worried about the princess running around. Besides, no one would want to throw snowballs at her...
say:6:1321760005:1.source_cn: 就算真的要打雪仗，先不说公主殿下能不能跑步，只怕也没人...

say:7:1321760006:1.text: Alright, enough of these sad musings... Ladies and gentlemen, come right up and test your skills at our <style="highlight">Doughball Fight</style>!
say:7:1321760006:1.source_cn: 不提这些难过的事啦。各位大人，快来试一试<style=...
